name: ai-relay
description: Claude, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot as coding agents over your project — one chat panel, your own accounts.

commands.title: AI Relay: Set Up an Agent

airelay.path.description: The airelay command, or the folder it is installed in. Blank: the usual install places and PATH are searched, then the CLI bundled in this extension is run on a Java 21+ found on the machine.

enumDescriptions: Apply file edits without asking; confirm commands
airelay.permissionMode.description: How freely the agent runs tools.

airelay.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments for every launch, e.g. --model NAME --no-web.

scripts.sync-cli: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src='../build/install/airelay/lib',dst='media/cli';fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.warn('No CLI build at '+src+' (run ./gradlew installDist at the root); packaging without the bundled CLI');process.exit(0);}fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src))if(f.endsWith('.jar'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f),p.join(dst,f));console.log('Bundled CLI: '+fs.readdirSync(dst).length+' jars');"
scripts.compile: npm run sync-chat && npm run sync-cli && tsc -p ./
